facts.fact: The SmartCare Pro programme managers' presentation states that SmartCare Legacy and SmartCare Plus are together used in approximately 1,800 healthcare facilities in 10 provinces; no denominator and no split by facility type; the slides are undated, so the published date (a proxy, March 2025) is used.
The presentation's timeline records SmartCare Plus version 1.6 scaled up to 350 facilities in 2022, with SmartCare Pro launched in 2023.

The presentation calls SmartCare Pro the latest version of the national electronic health record software and records that SmartCare was approved as the Ministry of Health standard in 2009; undated slides, so the published date (a proxy) is used.

The presentation describes SmartCare Pro as capturing the patient encounter at facility level, following clinical workflows with embedded guidelines and decision prompts, on a central server that identifies each client uniquely and lets patients be tracked between facilities in real time; undated slides, so the published date (a proxy) is used.
